scripts.build:react: npm run build:core && npm run build:styles && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-react
scripts.build:angular: npm run build:core && npm run build:styles && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular
scripts.build:react-native: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-react-native
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:core && npm run build:styles && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-react && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-react-native
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-react-example && npm run build -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular-example && npm --prefix examples/react-native run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:examples
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @akin2unde/flowui-core && npm run typecheck -w @akin2unde/flowui-react && npm run typecheck -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular && npm run typecheck -w @akin2unde/flowui-react-native
scripts.test: npm run test -w @akin2unde/flowui-core && npm run test -w @akin2unde/flowui-react && npm run test -w @akin2unde/flowui-react-native
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check
scripts.publish:packages: npm publish -w @akin2unde/flowui-core --access public && npm publish -w @akin2unde/flowui-react --access public && npm publish -w @akin2unde/flowui-angular --access public && npm publish -w @akin2unde/flowui-react-native --access public
scripts.setup:react-native-example: npm run build:react-native && npm --prefix examples/react-native install --workspaces=false
scripts.dev:react-native: npm run build:react-native && npm --prefix examples/react-native run start
scripts.dev:react-native:web: npm run build:react-native && npm --prefix examples/react-native run web
